ChainPointJSON.description: Indexed chain point baked into proof-bearing responses

DeleteRequest.description: Delete a key (value is the current stored value)

FactWitness.description: State witness plus MPF inclusion proof

Metrics.description: Metrics about CSMT operations and blockchain synchronization

RejectRequest.description: Reject Phase 3 expired requests for a token

RetractRequest.description: Retract a pending request. UTxO format: txhash#ix

StatusResponse.description: Indexer chain tip, checkpoint, and current UTxO-CSMT root

SweepRequest.description: Owner-only sweep of a non-legitimate UTxO at the per-cage request address. UTxO format: txhash#ix

SweepTxResponse.description: Unsigned sweep transaction. Sweep does not bundle a proof envelope (the on-chain validator enforces the owner-signature predicate against the referenced state UTxO).

SyncPhase.description: Current synchronization phase: restoring, replaying, following, or synced

TrieFactJSON.description: Trie read: key, optional value, and MPF proof against a trie root

UnsignedTxResponse.description: Uniform proof-bearing response for write endpoints. Carries the unsigned transaction CBOR plus a snapshot and a flat list of spent and reference inputs, each with its CSMT inclusion proof.

UpdateValueRequest.description: Update a key's value (old and new values)

UtxoEntry.description: UTxO ref, CBOR body, and CSMT inclusion proof against the enclosing snapshot's utxo_root

VerificationSnapshot.description: UTxO-CSMT root and indexed chain point against which bundled proofs are valid

WitnessedUtxo.description: UTxO reference, CBOR body, and UTxO-CSMT inclusion proof

info.description: HTTP service for the Cardano Merkle Patricia Forestry offchain node. Provides token lifecycle, trie queries, and transaction building endpoints.
info.title: MPFS HTTP API
